response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile full-stack engineer with strong craftsmanship, testing, and community-teaching credentials, but the resume does not meet the core hard requirements of this role. The minimum bar of 8 years of C++ programming is far from met — documented C/C++ work amounts to roughly 7 months at National Instruments plus a university thesis project, with C++ absent from the listed skills. His career is predominantly web/product oriented (TypeScript, Node.js, D, Ember), and while the Sociomantic role shows genuine low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems exposure, there is no evidence of building or leading large-scale cloud compute platforms, hardware/storage architecture, or holding a formal technical leadership role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers. Strong open-source ownership (GISCollective, Trial, Fluent-Asserts) and workshop facilitation suggest leadership potential, but not for a C++-centric compute platform.
strengths: Real high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems work at Sociomantic/Dunnhumby
Strong software craftsmanship: TDD, CI/CD, tooling, DevOps, open-source project ownership
Proven mentoring and knowledge-sharing via workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: C++ experience is roughly months, not the required 8 years
No large-scale cloud compute platform or hardware/storage architecture experience
No formal technical leadership title or evidence of leading cross-team technical strategy

key_factors.factor: Lack of cloud compute platform / infra-at-scale ownership
Distributed systems and mentoring/craftsmanship track record
